title: Simple weapon cooldown
description: Weapon Cooldowns reworks combat by adding unique cooldowns to each weapon, forcing players to rely on timing and decision making instead of spam clicking while keeping fights fair and skill based.
body:
⚔️ Weapon Cooldowns

Do you really think every weapon should feel the same?
If your answer is yes — this mod is not for you.

Weapon Cooldowns introduces a simple but brutal idea:
every weapon has a purpose, and every swing has a cost.

What changes?
– Each weapon has its own cooldown
– Spam-clicking is no longer viable
– Combat becomes timing-based, not panic-based

❓ Is it harder?
→ Yes. But fair. You lose because of bad timing — not randomness.

❓ Why does it matter?
→ Because vanilla combat becomes predictable. This forces you to actually improve.

🛠️ Commands:

/weaponcooldown set mace 5
→ Set mace cooldown to 5 seconds

/weaponcooldown set netherite_sword 1.5
→ Fine-tune high-tier weapon speed

/weaponcooldown list
→ View all current cooldowns

/weaponcooldown exempt add YourUsername
→ Exclude specific players from cooldowns

/weaponcooldown reload
→ Reload config without restarting
